description: Bundles a curated, hand-picked set of vault assets (recipes, components, looks, raw assets) into a single portable, shareable pack with provenance + integrity. action=pack gathers items into a <name>.pack/ directory tree with a JSON manifest and checksum manifest. action=unpack restores the tree, optionally verifying integrity. Fully offline — no TD bridge required.

include_provenance.description: Copy .provenance.json sidecars if present; else synthesize via provenanceStamp.

items.description: pack only. Files to include. Empty is an error.

out_dir.description: Absolute dir where the pack is written (pack) or restored into (unpack).

overwrite.description: Replace existing pack dir (pack) or existing files in out_dir (unpack).

pack_path.description: unpack only — path to existing <name>.pack/ or its pack.manifest.json.

vault_path.description: Root for resolving relative items[].path. Falls back to TDMCP_VAULT_PATH env.

verify_on_unpack.description: unpack only — re-run checksumAndVerifyPack after copy and fail if not OK.

name: curated_collection_pack
title: Curated Collection Pack
